ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 60-65% high-intensity white pixels on the lobes and 35-40% low-intensity black pixels localized in the central region and along the fluke margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous areas on the left and right lobes. A central low-intensity black mass extends from the peduncle attachment to the notch. The left lobe contains a distinct isolated black circular pixel cluster in the upper-outer quadrant and a complex dark geometric mark resembling a 'T' or 'L' in the mid-inner quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central notch exhibits a V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge. The distal tips exhibit sharp, high-amplitude peaks (8-12 pixels), while the medial trailing edge shows smoother, low-amplitude undulations (2-4 pixels).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave mathematical curve from the notch towards the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle attachment points) are visible along the extreme lateral margins and tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least three distinct, dark, parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe, oriented vertically and intersected by a secondary horizontal mark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark linear scarring (rake marks) on the left lobe; irregular yellow-brown pixel staining on the medial-lower portion of the right lobe lobe near the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, highly distinct black circular spot located in the white field of the upper-left fluke tip.
